captions.detailed: This 3D model features a rooftop CCTV pole constructed from dark grey steel. It stands on a square steel base plate, supporting a tall, cylindrical fixed-height pole. At the top of the pole sits a light grey pan-tilt yoke system, which allows the camera assembly to rotate horizontally (pan axis). Extending forward from this yoke is an arm holding a dome camera housing that can tilt vertically (tilt axis) to adjust its viewing angle.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a rooftop CCTV pole with a square base plate, a tall cylindrical steel pole, and a pan-tilt yoke system at the top. The yoke should support a forward-facing dome camera housing, with defined revolute joints for horizontal panning at the pole head and vertical tilting at the camera arm.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject by first building a fixed base link containing a thin, square box for the base plate and a tall cylinder for the main vertical pole. It then defines a 'yoke' part using a cylinder for the rotating head cap and a box for the horizontal extension arm, connected to the base via a continuous vertical pan joint. Finally, the 'camera' part is built using a combination of a box for the tilt-bracket, a cylinder for the upper dome cap, and a sphere (or dome-like cylinder) for the lens housing, connected to the yoke via a revolute tilt joint with specified angular limits.
